text: Browser Event Timeline read, including inline change requests. Aleca reported tab colors did not work on Windows11; Paenglab replied "Fixed with adding color-scheme: light dark; at the correct position. :-)" Aleca also requested omitting a variation when both colors are identical. After the backout, Paenglab reported resetColor() added --icon-color: #000000 instead of removing color. Aleca identified the JS default-folder-color consumer in folderProps.js and requested leaving folderColors.css unchanged because getPropertyValue() did not produce the required resolved color distinction. Paenglab replied "Removed this file." Aleca accepted the updated patch June3 and it relanded June4. The JS consumer exception describes this 2024 patch; inspect current code before applying it today.
